searchText: Sepolia shadowfork is live and gloas is in 4 hours <https://dora.glamsterdam-sepsf-1.ethpandaops.io/> looks unhealthy we don't have a snapshot of ethrex so we are snap syncing the nodes and erigons built in CL tripped me up, have to re download the snapshots for erigon <@199561711278227457> how about we schedule a partial devnet-8 shutdown next week? let's plan to talk about this on ACDT but I'd like to have by then already arranged some things we want to test. I am interested in 1) Make sure Prysm can sync from an unfinalized checkpoint (so we need a server for this) 2) Make sure the CB is actually working fine. 3) Try to add flags to fallback to direct connection builders. So perhaps try to aim for Wednesday? For 1 what do you mean a server? Just a client to serve unfinalized state via beacon api? yeah my impl needs the state and block too though
